meta.title: ProArq: compare construction suppliers
meta.description: Search construction materials from suppliers in China, India, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam. Compare price, minimum order and lead time, then request quotes.

home.title: Construction materials from five countries, compared line by line.
home.lead: Search products from suppliers in China, India, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam. Put price, minimum order and lead time next to each other, then request quotes from the ones that fit.
home.describe: Describe your project to the assistant

search.title: Search or describe what you need
search.body: Type a material, or tell the assistant about your project in plain words.

compare.title: Compare offers line by line
compare.body: Add up to four products and read price tiers, minimum order, lead time and certifications in one table.

quote.title: Request quotes from the suppliers you pick
quote.body: Send one request per supplier and follow every answer from your account.

footer.about: ProArq helps builders and architects compare construction suppliers across countries before they buy.
footer.sample: Demo catalog: suppliers, products and prices are sample data.
